title: Pokémon TCG MLX — TrainConfig
description: Configuration schema for the Pokémon TCG MLX training pipeline. Hierarchy: CLI args > --config file > configs/train_config.json > hardcoded defaults.

d_model.description: Transformer hidden dimension. Controls embedding size, attention width, and FFN input. Larger = more capacity but slower. 128=~1M params, 256=~3.5M, 512=~20M.

nhead.description: Number of attention heads in each Transformer layer. Must divide d_model evenly.

nlayers.description: Number of stacked Transformer encoder layers. More layers = deeper reasoning but slower and more memory.

ff_dim.description: Feed-forward network width inside each Transformer layer. Typically 4 × d_model.

static.description: Enable static card features (HP, type, retreat cost, etc.) from EN_Card_Data.csv. Adds a learned projection of domain attributes into model space.

split_heads.description: Use dedicated VALUE and SUBMIT tokens with separate output heads. VALUE token gets CLS scalars directly (short residual for prize counts). SUBMIT token feeds the submit logit.

structured.description: Enable verb-conditioned structured action head. Adds per-OptionType query and bias embeddings for scoring. Currently disabled for BC baseline.

scratch_registers.description: Number of scratch/workspace tokens inserted between state and option tokens. Used as inter-decision memory when TBPTT is enabled. Inspired by 'ViTs Need Registers'.

prefetch.description: Enable background slab prefetching. A separate thread loads the next memory-mapped slab while the GPU trains on the current one. Reduces I/O wait but uses more RAM (2 slabs in memory).

compile.description: Compile the training step with mx.compile for graph optimization. Faster after warmup but first call takes several minutes. Incompatible with gradient clipping (needs float() conversion).

log_interval.description: Print training stats (loss, LR, ETA) every N optimizer steps.

epochs.description: Number of training epochs. Each epoch iterates over all training data once (shuffled per-epoch).

batch_size.description: Training batch size. 128 is safe for M3 Pro 24GB. Reduce to 64 or 32 for smoke tests or if OOM.

accum_steps.description: Gradient accumulation steps. Splits each batch into K microbatches, accumulates gradients in FP32, then clips and updates once. Effective batch = batch_size × accum_steps. 1 = no accumulation.

lr.description: Peak learning rate for Adam optimizer.

lr_schedule.description: Learning rate decay schedule after warmup. 'cosine' = cosine annealing to lr×lr_min_ratio. 'linear' = linear decay. 'none' = constant lr.

warmup_steps.description: Number of linear warmup steps from 0 to peak LR. Scheduler counts optimizer updates (not forward passes). Clamped to max(total_steps/5, 1).

lr_min_ratio.description: Minimum LR = lr × lr_min_ratio. After decay schedule completes, LR holds at this floor (Orbit-style).

max_grad_norm.description: Max gradient norm for clipping. Applied once after accumulation (not per microbatch). 0 = disabled.

seed.description: Random seed for reproducibility. Affects slab shuffling, batch ordering, and validation split.

slab_rows.description: Number of rows per memory-mapped slab (I/O unit). 32k rows × ~14KB/row ≈ 450MB. With prefetch, 2 slabs ≈ 900MB. Reduce for smoke tests (500) or low-memory machines.

val_frac.description: Fraction of data reserved for validation. Split falls on episode boundary when episode_meta.npy exists.

max_rows.description: Maximum training rows to use. 0 = all rows (no limit). Set to 1000 for smoke tests.

tbptt_chunk.description: TBPTT chunk size (decisions per chunk). 0 = disabled (shuffled training). When >0, requires episode_meta.npy. Groups rows by (episode_id, side) in temporal order. stop_gradient at chunk boundaries. Typical: 8, 16, or 32.

data_dir.description: Directory for encoded BC datasets (.npy files). Each subdirectory is one dataset (e.g., bc_2026_07_25/).

replay_zip_dir.description: Directory for downloaded Kaggle replay zips. Each zip is one day of episodes.

checkpoint_dir.description: Directory for training checkpoints (.pkl). Best model saved here during training.

model_dir.description: Directory for the final best model. Copied from checkpoint_dir at end of training.

bc_workers.description: Number of parallel worker processes for BC dataset building. Each worker encodes one episode independently.

bc_flush.description: Number of episodes per shard in batch processing. Each shard is flushed to disk as a numbered directory. Bounds peak RAM to one shard of results.

bc_ep_timeout.description: Timeout per episode during BC dataset building (seconds). Episodes exceeding this are skipped.

max_episodes.description: Maximum episodes to process from replay zips. 0 = all episodes. Set to 10 for smoke tests.

bc_would_ko.description: Enable would_ko simulation in BC dataset builder. Adds would_ko rate, expected prizes, and P(ends game) to option features. Requires search_agent.

bc_wk_nvar.description: Number of variable-attack determinizations for would_ko simulation. Higher = more accurate but slower.

bc_both_sides.description: Encode both sides (player 0 and player 1) from each episode. Doubles the data per episode.

value_atoms.description: Number of atoms for categorical value head. Only used when value_categorical=True in model. More atoms = finer value distribution.

value_vmax.description: Maximum absolute value for categorical value head support. Support spans [-vmax, vmax] uniformly. Only used when value_categorical=True.

kaggle_episodes_prefix.description: Kaggle dataset name prefix for daily episode datasets. Full name = prefix + '-YYYY-MM-DD'.
